# 01:05 8 Oct: round nine (docs/SCREENS.md, ninth round; relcols.py): compiled columns step 1's pick leaves out and
# the published systems use. rel: 26 question-relation columns (0 on the passage graphs); gcs: GraphER's two-step
# propagation of retrieval's scores. Thirteen CPU builds (each checks the chunks' step-1 columns against step 1's
# cached xc and n bit for bit), the smoke, two fits per arm (L-musique, L-hotpotqa) ahead of every gated full run,
# their reads, comparisons, pair verdicts and re-calls under the seed null (the re-call decides). rel's caps carry

# 07:40 8 Oct: round fifteen (docs/SCREENS.md, docs/FULL_ROUND15.md): zrs, rmatch's match trained on zret's
# frozen fit of each split, decided against zret's fits. The smoke, two screen fits, their pair and re-call; the
